Operator nomination, owner acceptance, and policy commitment are confirmed. The policy has no denied deployments or app versions and does not require catalog approval. Future deny-list changes require this host owner wallet. No independent host is enrolled or modified.

The current production host/chain source was compared before deployment. The node entry point was identical; the changes add wallet admission and immutable contract pins. Thirteen relevant tests and a live Windows preflight for all nine running deployments passed. Only the node controller restarted. All guest VM IDs remained unchanged; nine deployments and nine network apps were ready afterward. Runtime file hashes and activation evidence are alongside this report. The controller retains its prior three-RPC configuration.

This is host-local admission, not complete censorship resistance. Live secret release, measurement/certificate issuance, legacy control and Sia/indexd still rely on Nan. Independent-host/custodian survival under an Enclave veto and a complete Nan outage have not been demonstrated. No production deny-list test was performed against a running app.
